narratives.Description: Route structured vBRIEF mutations through one instrumented CRUD tool so real dogfooding emits per-operation metrics tagged with the directive version. Metrics include schema-validity, field-invention, byte-diff minimality, and workflow-level gate-pass-first-try and turns-per-workflow counters.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Add an instrumented CRUD module that wraps vBRIEF create, read, update, and delete and records per-operation metrics tagged with the version.
- Emit schema-validity and byte-diff-minimality metrics and add tests with fixtures covering valid and field-invention mutations.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want per-operation mutation telemetry tagged by version, so that I can measure whether a new version is easier for agents to use correctly.
narratives.Traces: #1703 Tier 1; #742 CRUD instrumentation (the unbuilt scripts/vbrief_crud.py artifact).

narrative.Acceptance: The CRUD chokepoint records per-operation metrics each tagged with the directive version.
When an agent invents a non-spec key, the tool records a field-invention metric.
The tool persists a byte-diff minimality metric distinguishing whole-file rewrites from surgical patches.

expected_outputs: Instrumented CRUD chokepoint emitting per-version metrics

references.title: Issue #1703: RFC: measuring directive version-over-version performance -- tiered framework-eval model
